## Activity timeouts
Judged from the activity attempts: a timeout or a retry limit that does not fit what was seen.

spec.title: Activity timeouts findings detected
spec.description: Findings of this kind detected in the time range shown.

## Deploy findings
Judged from the deploys and what the pipeline wrote about them.

spec.title: Deploy findings findings detected
spec.description: Findings of this kind detected in the time range shown.

options.content:
## Gaps
Judged from what the server did not receive: a namespace not pulled and an instance with no metrics.

spec.title: Gaps findings detected
spec.description: Findings of this kind detected in the time range shown.

options.content:
## Worker health
Judged from the metrics each worker exports through the SDK: slots, cache, task and replay times, activities, pollers and calls to the server.

spec.title: Worker health findings detected
spec.description: Findings of this kind detected in the time range shown.

options.content:
## Engine health
Judged from the metrics the Temporal server exports: task queues, rate limits, its database, workflow tasks, activity timeouts, history size and the history service.

spec.title: Engine health findings detected
spec.description: Findings of this kind detected in the time range shown.

options.content:
## Rules on stored data
Each new or changed rule applied once to the data already stored (FPP-133): the findings it took back as mistaken, and the stored runs it walked and skipped.

spec.title: Findings marked mistaken
spec.description: Findings a new rule version took back in the time range shown.

spec.title: Stored runs walked
spec.description: Stored runs a rule was applied to, per second, by rule.

spec.title: Stored runs skipped
spec.description: Stored runs a rule could not be applied to because their history is not stored, per second, by rule.
